title: EU Climate & Energy Daily Briefing
subtitle: Tuesday, 27 October 2026 — Key developments from the last 24 hours

highlights.headline: Commission launches T-MED Investment Platform with up to €4.5 billion in EU guarantees
highlights.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 26 Oct 2026 Today, the European Commission launched the T-MED Investment Platform, to mobilise large-scale investment in renewable energy and clean technologies across the Mediterranean. The platform is a key component of the Trans-Mediterranean Renewable Energy and Clean Tech Cooperation Initiative (T-MED), a flagship initiative of the Pact for the Mediterranean.

highlights.headline: Lula’s election win in Brazil raises hopes for zero deforestation drive
highlights.summary: Lula’s re-election makes it more likely Brazil can meet a key goal to end forest loss in the Amazon and builds confidence in a new fund to protect the world's rainforests, experts say The post Lula’s election win in Brazil raises hopes for zero deforestation drive appeared first on Climate Home News.

items.title: Storm Boelo leaves 22,000 without power as Met Office issues new wind warning
items.description: A yellow warning for strong winds came in effect at 18:00 on Monday across the west coast of England, Wales and Scotland and eastern parts of Northern Ireland.
